audit_summary: Vermithor is fully verified and authorized for supervised customer pilot execution in Sanitized Postmortem Replay Mode. Live customer VPC telemetry remains strictly labeled as NOT VERIFIED pending deployment of customer VPC OpenTelemetry collectors.

supported_integrations.name: Sanitized Incident Postmortem Replay Fixtures
supported_integrations.network_access_required: None (local filesystem read of sanitized JSON fixtures)
supported_integrations.endpoint_validation: Local file path validation against directory traversal and null bytes
sensitive_fields_redacted: PostgreSQL / MySQL connection strings with plaintext passwords
supported_integrations.external_llm_egress: Disabled by default under Pilot Governance Policy (runs via local deterministic rules)
supported_integrations.purge_behavior: Immediate cascading deletion from database and local cache upon administrator command
supported_integrations.disconnection_behavior: Immediate transition to REVOKED; subsequent shadow runs blocked

supported_integrations.name: Prometheus Metrics Server (PromQL HTTP API)
supported_integrations.network_access_required: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS to customer-approved Prometheus endpoint (:9090 or custom)
supported_integrations.endpoint_validation: SSRF protected; rejects cloud metadata (169.254.*), loopback (127.0.0.1), multicast, and userinfo credentials. Rejects redirects (301/302).
supported_integrations.authentication_mechanism: Bearer Token or HTTP Basic Auth; secrets masked in storage (e.g. 'Bearer ***8877')

permissions_requested.write_operations: Strictly prohibited (no remote-write, no alertmanager silences)

supported_integrations.ssrf_protection: Strict IP checking, prohibited metadata blacklist, DNS rebinding validation, follow_redirects=False
sensitive_fields_redacted: Tokens redacted from PromQL query labels and error messages
Metric observation labels scrubbed of user identifiers
supported_integrations.external_llm_egress: Disabled unless administrator explicitly enables allow_external_llm in governance policy
supported_integrations.purge_behavior: Full purge removes all ingested MetricObservation records and Redis cached queries
supported_integrations.disconnection_behavior: Immediately revokes credentials; telemetry collection paused; subsequent polling returns REVOKED
blockers: Customer VPC OpenTelemetry/Prometheus collector not yet connected in live customer environment

supported_integrations.name: Jaeger Query API / OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing
supported_integrations.network_access_required: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS to customer-approved Jaeger Query endpoint (:16686 or custom)
supported_integrations.endpoint_validation: SSRF protected; rejects cloud metadata (169.254.*), loopback (127.0.0.1), multicast, and userinfo credentials. Rejects redirects.
supported_integrations.authentication_mechanism: Bearer Token or Header Key; masked in storage
supported_integrations.ssrf_protection: Strict IP checking, prohibited metadata blacklist, DNS rebinding validation, follow_redirects=False
sensitive_fields_redacted: Trace span tag values matching passwords, auth tokens, JWTs, and credit card patterns scrubbed before persistence
supported_integrations.external_llm_egress: Disabled by default under Pilot Governance Policy
supported_integrations.purge_behavior: Purges all ingested Event and Trace correlation records from Postgres and Redis
supported_integrations.disconnection_behavior: Immediately revokes provider; subsequent trace queries blocked
blockers: Customer VPC distributed tracing agent pending customer network security team sign-off

supported_integrations.name: GitHub Read-Only Repository Connection
supported_integrations.network_access_required: Outbound HTTPS to https://api.github.com on port 443
supported_integrations.endpoint_validation: Strict regex validation on owner/repo slug; blocks directory traversal, null bytes, SSRF loopback
supported_integrations.authentication_mechanism: GitHub App Private Key (PEM) or Fine-Grained Personal Access Token (Read-Only)
supported_integrations.ssrf_protection: Strict domain restriction to api.github.com; denies external redirects
sensitive_fields_redacted: Repository tokens and PEM contents masked in memory and excluded from all logs/APIs
supported_integrations.external_llm_egress: Source code inspected only in local sandbox; diffs generated without external transmission if LLM egress is disabled
supported_integrations.purge_behavior: Purges all repair proposals, validation diffs, and disconnected repository connection records
supported_integrations.disconnection_behavior: Endpoint POST /api/v1/agent/repositories/{id}/disconnect sets REVOKED; blocks all further file fetches
